_doc: Sapphire's ash-covered trees and ash grass drawn with Black 2's snowy winter art (user decision 2026-10-06: snowy trees stand in for ash). Only the maps listed here, and only their ash tiles: a tree is ashy where Sapphire draws it in non-green colours (mean green - red of its metatiles below 'max_green': Route 113's ash trees 15 or less, Jagged Pass's and Mt. Chimney's pink-grey ones about -40, green trees 50-80; Jagged Pass keeps its green trees by Route 112), plus the forest world.py grows outside the maps next to a map whose trees are all ashy (Route 113). Ash grass tiles (class ash_grass) get the snowy ground and the snowy tall-grass tops. The art: Icirrus's winter set (a/0/1/4 entry 45, area 42 + winter), the same textures Hoenn's trees and grass use, same sizes and formats, copied into Hoenn's set 3 under new names ('textures': new name -> [set, Black 2 name]; palettes <new name>_pl) by patches/hoenn_textures.py (nsbtx.merge renamed copies). Black 2 loads one area per field (notes/GEN5_MAPS.md), so Route 113, on the connected matrix, cannot have an area of its own: renamed textures in the shared set keep the winter art to these tiles. world.py renames the ash tiles' materials ('trees', 'ash_grass': Hoenn texture -> snowy one). Since 2026-10-09 (map_glitch_fix) the ash lies on all of Sapphire's ash-grey ground: 'ground' is the texture of every ash-coloured grass/tree tile of these maps (and of the snowy forest outside an all-ash map), 'ash_grass' renames all the ash grass's tall-grass layers to winter art (Icirrus's olive kusa_ec2 under the snow-capped kusa_ec1, as Black 2's own winter routes), 'lips' the grass lips of cliffs and raised ground within a tile of ash ground (snow on the lip): Route 113's patches of snow-capped grass on a green summer lawn read as boxes.
